title: Bitcoin Price Holds Near $65,000 as Nvidia Turmoil Drags Nasdaq Down 2.5%
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Holds Near $65,000 as Nvidia Turmoil Drags Nasdaq Down 2.5% Bitcoin price held near $65,000 on Monday afternoon, shrugging off a 2.5% Nasdaq slide as Nvidia's board ruled out bringing back Jensen Huang and the dollar hit a 19-month high. This post Bitcoin Price Holds Near $65,000 as Nvidia Turmoil Drags Nasdaq Down 2.5% first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
